description: This file defines the KubeTemplatePrintFlags struct and associated methods for handling template printing flags in Kubernetes CLI, including allowed formats, printer creation, and flag binding.

classes.name: KubeTemplatePrintFlags
classes.description: Struct that composes print flags for both JSONPath and go-template printers, with methods to handle allowed formats, printer creation, and flag addition.

methods.name: AllowedFormats
methods.description: Returns a combined list of allowed formats from GoTemplatePrintFlags and JSONPathPrintFlags.

methods.name: ToPrinter
methods.description: Creates and returns a resource printer based on the specified output format, supporting --template printing.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Binds template-related flags to a given cobra.Command.

methods.name: NewKubeTemplatePrintFlags
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new KubeTemplatePrintFlags instance with default values.
